=== Numerals ===
Numerals fit are nine rows high (except zero) and three columns wide. Avatarian uses a base-10 positional system for writing numbers. Numerals are written one digit at a time. Each one is the full height of a block and stands on its own beside the writing, the way punctuation does, rather than sharing a block with a sound.
